headline: Agenda notice lists items including minutes approval, correspondence, trust and superintendent reports, and old and new business.
summary: This document is a meeting notice, not minutes. It lists the agenda items and a contact for accommodation requests. It records no votes or decisions.
plain_text:
September 8, 2026
A meeting of the Board of Trustees of Cemeteries will be held on 
Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at 5:00 P.M. at the Forest Dale 
Cemetery Office, 150 Forest Street, Malden, Massachusetts.
 Please Note: “If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please 
contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 
781-397-7000, Ext 2005”
Meeting Agenda
 Approval of Minutes
 Correspondence
 Trust Report
 Superintendent’s Report
 Old Business
 New Business
 General Cemetery Business
